time_contract.parent_request_timeout: At each parent attempt, remaining=parent_deadline-now. timeout=min(90,remaining/number_of_remaining_parent_batches), without v4's factor2 or review consumption. Requests are admitted only with remaining positive and enough request slots for one initial request per remaining batch plus the present request; two physical attempts per batch maximum. A failed initial attempt does not entitle an unlimited retry or renew the deadline.

time_contract.review_admission: Only after the full parent answer has been written and validated. At each optional review require physical headroom and remaining unit time>R_save+minimum useful review allocation. Fixed useful review allocation10seconds is an admission floor, not an accuracy claim. Timeout=min(60,(unit_deadline-now-R_save)/remaining_review_batches). No review begins if that cap<10. Never spend saved parent/output reserve, and no repair attempt is added for elective review failure.
time_contract.socket_limit: Existing urllib timeout is a socket-operation bound, not proof of whole response walltime. Clock is rechecked before every request and immediately afterward; late review output cannot replace the saved full parent after deadline. Whole-response hard-deadline enforcement would be a distinct later runtime mechanism, not silently added here.

request_contract.parent_reservation: Before retrying a failed current parent, reserve one physical initial request for each later uncompleted parent batch; if impossible, stop with explicit full-roster failure. A complete parent is never discarded by an elective child.
request_contract.reviews: After all parents, deterministic originalbatch order; no taskID or postoutcome prioritization. Revieweachbatch atmostonce whileheadroomallows. Valid unchanged child accepted; numerically changedchild mustmeet exactexisting revision-basis rules. Failed/malformed/truncated/invalid/timeoutchild retains exact parentbatch and laterreview continues only with realheadroom.
request_contract.publication: No partial roster is advertised as complete. Before allparents, each batch's verified answer is persisted privately. After allparents, completeparent published atomically; successfulchild batches modify a private full-answer copy, validated then atomically published. Failed elective work never erases lastcompleteparent. Persistentwrite failure recorded and stops; do not synthesize rows.
